forget.supervision: suffix only; supplied answer prefix unscored

chat_retain.supervision: suffix only; supplied answer prefix unscored

objective: teacher-forced cross-entropy to each record's distinct target_response + JSD(p_model || p_clean) on retain/chat-retain

sampling.state_order: start then end for each selected source

ordinary_preference_setup.objective: CE: mean of per-state mean suffix NLL. DPO: mean of two pairs per state, beta-scaled chosen-minus-rejected summed suffix logprob improvement over cached actual parent. No auxiliary prefix weighting or DPO length normalization.
ordinary_preference_setup.encoding: Chat generation prompt plus unscored separately encoded prefix, then separately encoded suffix and EOS1. End chosen suffix is exactly one EOS token. No clipping.
ordinary_preference_setup.rng: Independent source shuffle seed+1000; auxiliary forward forks/restores Torch RNG. Both start/end states and two cyclic bank indices per visit.
